text.Storage Silo:
How to Play ==
When you play Storage Silo you gain 2 authority. When the ally ability triggers you gain 2 trade. The Storage Silo is a base with 3 defense.
 Strategy ==
With a cost of only 2 trade this looks a cheap buy to get a base up. But beware this flymsy base loses its purpose quite quickly when you enter midgame. This because its stats are just too low. Maybe it was a little better if the +2 Trade was the primary ability or if it could scrap itself.
